I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’ve built an HR attrition and absence dashboard for a confidential manufacturing client, where each plant manager could only see their own plant, and it covered 1,900 employees. I also built a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture, replacing 14 separate Excel sales reports with one Power BI report, which reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours.

For your contact research and list-building project, I can help identify the right people, gather names, titles, emails, and phone numbers, and organize everything cleanly in your Excel template. I’m comfortable with high-volume research and careful data entry, and I can provide a small sample first to ensure quality.
